paite: Gentheite kianga tanchin hoih gen dinga Toupan thau hon nilh jiakin Toupa Pathian kha ka tungah a om; aman, lungtang khasiate tuam ding bang, salte kianga pawtna thu leh mi tangte kianga tanin honna thu gen ding bang.
english: The Spirit of the Lord Yahweh is on me; because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and release to those who are bound;

paite: Toupa lungkim kum thu leh i Pathian phu lak ni thu gen ding bang, lungkhamte tengteng lungmuan ding bang,
english: to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all who mourn;

paite: Vut tanga pakkhigui bang, lungkham tanga nuamna thau bang, nguina kha tanga phatna puansilh bang a kiang ua piak ding Ziona lungkhamna omte adinga seh ding bang in a hon sawl ahi: amah pahtawia a omna dingin, diktatna sing Toupa suante chih, a hih theihna ding un.
english: to appoint to those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahweh, that he may be glorified.

paite: Huan, mun lui sesate a lem nawn ding ua, tumaa khua na sesate a dinghoih sak nawn ding ua, khopi sesa, suan tampi gamnate, a bawl hoih nawn ding uh.
english: They shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.

paite: Huan, mundang miten na gan honte uh dingin a vak ding ua, theihngeilouh mite na leiletmi ding un leh na grep gui uh kemmi dingin a om ding uh.
english: Strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and foreigners shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.

paite: Nou bel, Toupa siampute, chiha, lohin na om ding uh: miten I Pathian nasemmite a on chi ding uh; namchih sum na ne ding ua, a thupina uh na suang ding uh.
english: But you shall be named the priests of Yahweh; men will call you the ministers of our God: you will eat the wealth of the nations, and you will boast in their glory.

paite: Na zahlakna gun uh azahnih na mu ding ua; na zum gun ding un na tantuan uah nuamsain la na sa ding uh; huaijiakin na gam uah azahnih na luah ding ua; khantawn nuamsakna nou-a ahi ding.
english: Instead of your shame you shall have double; and instead of dishonor they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess double; everlasting joy shall be to them.

paite: Kei Toupa in vaihawmna diktat ka deih ngal naka, thulimlou taka hiamgam jaw ka hua hi; huchiin amau ka thukna chihtak ngialin a kianguah ka pe dinga, a kiang uah khantawn thu leng ka khung ding.
english: “For I, Yahweh, love justice, I hate robbery with iniquity; and I will give them their recompense in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

paite: Huchiin a suante uh namchih laka theih ahi ding ua, a tate uh leng mi chih laka theih ahi ding uh: amau muten Toupa vualjawl chi ahi uh chih a thei ding uh.
english: Their seed shall be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples; all who see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which Yahweh has blessed.”

paite: Toupa ah nakpi takin nuam ka sa dinga, ka hinna ka Pathian ah kipak takin a om ding; mou neipa ding pak khiguia kizep jel bang leh, mou ding leng a kivatna te-a a kivan jel bang in, aman hotdamna puansilhte a honsilhsaka, diktatna puannak tualin a hontuamta ngal a.Leitung in a thil dawn a pawtsak bang leh, huanin a sunga thil chinte a dawnsak bangin, Toupa Pathian in diktatna leh phatna nam chiteng maah a dawnkhe sak sin ngala.
english: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation, he has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

paite: Leitung in a thil dawn a pawtsak bang leh, huanin a sunga thil chinte a dawnsak bangin, Toupa Pathian in diktatna leh phatna nam chiteng maah a dawnkhe sak sin ngala.
english: For as the earth brings forth its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord Yahweh will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
